text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Association of francophone airlines operating in Africa lobby to cut computer prices.
- Morocco, World Bank and European Union to organise seminar in Casablanca on March 11, entitled "Morocco-EU, what strategy to take up challenge of the free trade zone".
- Morocco-Iran trade commission vows to strengthen cooperation.
- Trial of customs officers jailed last year on smuggling charges postponed to March 12.
- King Hassan and Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat call for meeting of Jerusalem committee.
